capabilities: Chat with the vault using retrieval from an embedding index of the notes
Proofread, rewrite, expand, summarize, translate and fact-check selected text with approval before replacing
Index notes for semantic and keyword search and show related notes in a side panel
Suggest tags and write frontmatter summaries and concept notes
Run web and vault skills such as Wikipedia search, DuckDuckGo search, vault queries and custom APIs
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Settings render as native Obsidian pages only from version 1.13; earlier versions show them as collapsible sections.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistance, and users who want one need a way to keep their notes private by running models locally.

relations.evidence: PDFs can be indexed through the Text Extractor plugin.

requires.name: llama.cpp, Ollama or LM Studio for local providers
API key for cloud providers (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Mistral)

summary: Private AI assistant that chats with your notes, proofreads and rewrites selected text, indexes the vault for semantic search, and runs extensible skills.
